The esthesis EDGE Enedis module allows you to fetch data from the Enedis DataHub API.
Metering data is fetched using the Enedis DataHub "mesure_synchrone_auto v2" API (mesure_synchrone_auto/v2). The data the module supports includes:
- Daily consumption (dc), for consumer PRMs. - Daily consumption max power (dcmp), for consumer PRMs. - Consumption load curve (clc), for consumer PRMs. - Daily production (dp), for producer PRMs. - Production load curve (plc), for producer PRMs. Each data type can be enabled or disabled individually, see the Enedis module configuration.
